title: HUNT-29-01 ES|QL aggregation result — repeated low-and-slow credential guess
event_type: ES|QL query result row, STATS ... BY source.ip, user.name, user.password_guess (honeynet SSH decoy telemetry)

callouts.explanation: The single decoy-facing source (176.53.159.196) HUNT-12-01 originally identified by hand; grouping by this field is what HUNT-29-01's Blind Spot box warns breaks against a distributed credential-stuffing run.

47 retries clears the WHERE attempts >= 3 filter easily, but the count alone is not the signal — it is the same exact (account, credential) pair repeating that distinguishes this from ordinary noisy scanning.

Paired with user.name = support, this is the exact repeated credential guess the hunt pivots on; user.password_guess is a custom field, not a standard ECS field, so its presence depends entirely on this honeypot's own ingestion mapping.

Combined with first_seen, this spans roughly two weeks (well past the DATE_DIFF("hours", first_seen, last_seen) >= 24 threshold), showing the pacing that would evade any short-window count-based detection rule.

note: Illustrative and conceptual only — this represents what a Kibana Discover result row would look like if the honeynet's SSH events were forwarded into an Elastic Stack instance; it is not a captured product screenshot.
